decisions.decision: Explicit loan with lottery: lottery bonds / præmieobligationer, not ordinary lottery tickets. Follow-up lecturer counterfeits the same bonds.

Broader securities / værdipapirer used, preserving unspecified instrument. Context distinguishes cash and securities; later redemption scene distinguishes forged instrument from banknotes received. This is contextual inference, not proof of specific instrument denomination.

Maintain distinction between counterfeit securities redeemed and banknotes received. Both modern drafts had also reversed direction of payment: man RECEIVED 5000 rubles, did not arrive with 5000. Corrected both languages from Russian II/VI and Garnett.
